name: Sarnacol-2152
paste:
SARNACOL®-2152: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sarnacol®-2152, April 2023, Version 03.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/6/sarnacol_-2152.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sarnacol®-2152 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.01).
1.2 Product description. Two components polyurethane adhesive.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sarnacol®-2152 is used to adhere Sarnafil® G 476 (unexposed), Sarnafil® G 410 L Felt (exposed) on concrete.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.7.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sarnacol®-2152
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Two component adhesive for Sarnafil® G 476 and Sarnafil® G 410 L Felt Roofing Applications
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Quality management system EN ISO 9001
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN ISO 9001: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Adheres to solid, rough and clean concrete or cement mortar substrate
    - Solvent-free
    - Cold-applied (no heat or open flames required)
    - No lateral water migration between the concrete structure and the membrane system
    - Thixotropic
    - Primer free application
2.5 Composition.
    | Component A | Polyols, filled |
    | Component B | Isocyanate derivatives |
2.6 Density.
    | Component A | ~1.6 kg/l |
    | Component B | ~1.2 kg/l |
    | Component A + B | ~1.5 kg/l |
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Storage conditions: Dry storage at temperature from +5 °C up to +30 °C. Protect from direct sunlight, rain, snow, ice, humidity, etc.
2.8 Packaging.
    | Component A | 25 kg pail |
    | Component B | 5 kg pail |
    | Component A + B | 30 kg set |
2.9 Shelf life.
    | Component A | 12 months¹⁾ |
    | Component B | 9 months¹⁾ |
    1) From date of production if stored properly in orginal, unopened and undamaged sealed container.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality - Reinforced concrete structure must be.
    - Hardened and of sufficient compressive strength, minimum 25 N/mm²,
    - With a minimum pull off strength 1.5 N/mm²
    - Dry, sound, clean and free of any contaminations (e.g. dust, oil, grease, release agent)
    - Free from surface defects (e.g. blowholes, voids, honeycombing, cracks, protrusions)
3.3 Substrate preparation. The concrete or other suitable cementitious substrate must meet the defined substrate quality. If the substrate does not fulfil the requirements, the surface must be pre-treated prior to the application in order to prevent any subsequent damage to the membrane sheets.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: Component A : Component B = 100 : 19 (by weight)
    - Consumption: Consumption depends on the roughness and absorbency of the substrate and is about 500–1 000 g/m².
    - Curing time: Full cure ~4 hours at +23 °C / +50 % r.h. The curing time of Sarnacol®-2152 is dependent on the ambient temperature.
4.3 Pot Life.
    | Temperature | Pot Life |
    | + 20 °C | 30 min. |
    | + 30 °C | 15 min. |
4.4 Mixing.
    - Mix components A+B together in the correct proportion into a suitable mixing pail for 3-5 minutes with a low speed mixer until the material becomes smooth in consistency and has a uniform white colour. Avoid aeration while mixing the 2 components.
    - Mix only that quantity which can be used within its pot life.
4.5 Application. Apply membrane on substrate, marking lines for application. Roll up membrane. Apply the adhesive on the substrate with spatula or squegge. Unroll Sarnafil® G 476, Sarnafil® G 410 L Felt on to adhesive, pay attention to the extruded adhesive on both sides and clean up timely, to avoid any pollution to the membrane which may affect the welding. Press membrane surface lightly to make membrane and adhesive contact each other thoroughly. After adhesive is cured, welding can be started.
4.6 Cleaning of equipment.
    - After application, tools and devices must be cleaned immediately with Sika® Colma Cleaner or SikaForce®- 7260 Cleaner. Hardened and cured material can only be removed mechanically.
    - Hands and exposed skin should be washed immediately using Sika® Handclean Towel or a suitable industrial hand cleaner and water.
    - Do not use solvent!
4.7 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Installation work must be carried out by Sika trained Sarnafil® contractors only.
    - The substrate quality and condition must be fulfilled or appropriate measures must be taken to ensure it is fulfilled.
    - After the installation is completed, it is recommended to protect the Sarnafil® G 476 system immediately to prevent any mechanical damage and at least after 3 months, due to the UV exposure.
    - Sarnafil® G 476 is not permanently UV and weather resistant. Therefore, they must not be installed on structures permanently exposed to UV light and weathering.
    - Special measures may be relevant for the method of application / system installation due to health and safety requirements in accordance with all relevant local regulations.
    - High temperatures will shorten the pot life and speed up the curing process. Low temperatures will prolong the pot life and slow the curing process.
    - For more detail information and assistance please refer to the current Method Statement for Sarnafil® G 410 L Felt and Sarnafil® G 476.
    - Not suitable for application on bitumen, tar, EPS, XPS, PIR

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. min. + 5 °C / max. + 40°C
5.3 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.7):
    - High temperatures will shorten the pot life and speed up the curing process. Low temperatures will prolong the pot life and slow the curing process.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sarnacol®-2152, April 2023, Version 03.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/6/sarnacol_-2152.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sarnacol®-2152 Part A, version 31/08/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sds-sarnacol-2152parta.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sarnacol®-2152 Part B, version 31/08/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sds-sarnacol-2152partb.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SarnacolÂ®-2152 Part A, https://aus.sika.com/dam/dms/au01/a/sds-sarnacol-2152parta.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
